headline: Bijan Robinson powers Falcons past Saints 45-24 on the 20th anniversary of the Superdome's reopening
summary: — Bijan Robinson ensured there would be no punt to block this time — and the Atlanta Falcons were off and running.

headline: Resurgent Falcons score 80 points in two-game winning streak
summary: The 2-2 Falcons had a combined 16 points, the lowest total in the NFL, through two weeks, but after a 45-24 victory over the rival New Orleans Saints on "Monday Night Football," Atlanta now has a league-high 80 combined points in a two-game winning surge.

headline: Bears To Start QB Tyson Bagent In Week 5
summary: Caleb Williams will miss a third straight game. The Bears switched from Case Keenum to Tyson Bagent in terms of his replacement, but another swap on the depth chart will not be coming this week. headline: Jim Harbaugh not happy with reporter for "more insult than question" about Justin Herbert
summary: Chargers head coach Jim Harbaugh was not happy with a reporter's line of questioning about quarterback Justin Herbert and the Chargers' inability to build a successful offense around him amid the team's 0-4 start.

headline: Falcons average NFL-high 40.0 points with Michael Penix, after NFL-low 8.0 without him
summary: Falcons safety Jessie Bates wasn't exaggerating when he said they're a different team with Michael Penix.
